reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it presents BNB Winery as an investment promising 8–11% daily returns while requiring a minimum BNB deposit and encouraging participation through wallet connection and referral rewards. The speaker recommends joining the project, although a general risk warning and on-screen disclaimer are also shown.

citations.quote: This project already has a very big message and I recommend that you become a part of it.
Earn 8-11% daily ROI on your BNB token.
Investing in any project is a risk. You shall remember this.
BnB Winnery is a cross-chain oriented, centralized, high-yield investment program with very low fees and a long-term project.
Minimal deposit is 0.01 BNB and no maximum limit.

opening.argument: The presentation expressly gives viewers a risk warning before discussing the project: “Investing in any project is a risk.” Its language is also conditional rather than a guarantee: the return is described as “up to 11%,” and the stated percentage depends on usage and fluctuations. That framing is consistent with investment commentary that presents a possible opportunity while acknowledging uncertainty, not with an unconditional assurance that viewers will profit. The speaker also describes the subject as a project to analyze, rather than claiming that participation is risk-free or that returns are already secured.

citations.quote: Investing in any project is a risk. You shall remember this.
Daily percentage is up to 11%.
This depends on drinking habits. The time of day you are getting a deposit and TPL fluctuations.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account emphasizes the headline return and minimum deposit but omits the material qualifications. “Up to” 11% is not a promise of 11%, and the speaker specifically says returns vary with stated conditions. The risk warning is not hidden or implied; it is introduced as an important warning before the discussion. The cited recommendation therefore must be read alongside an express acknowledgment that investing involves risk, not as a guarantee.

citations.quote: But first, an important warning. This video is not Financial Days. Investing in any project is a risk. You shall remember this.
Daily percentage is up to 11%.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: A generic risk disclaimer does not neutralize the surrounding message. The speaker still presents the program as offering “8-11% daily ROI,” calls it a “high-yield investment program,” and recommends joining it. Those are substantive promotional claims, while the warning does not explain that the advertised returns may be unreliable or that viewers should avoid depositing funds. Conditional wording about the percentage does not change the investment solicitation.

citations.quote: Earn 8-11% daily ROI on your BNB token.
BnB Winnery is a cross-chain oriented, centralized, high-yield investment program with very low fees and a long-term project.
This project already has a very big message and I recommend that you become a part of it.

opening.argument: The speaker identifies the activity as analysis: “we will analyze a project that I personally found interesting.” The video then discusses the project’s stated mechanics, changing percentages, fees, deposit threshold, and referral structure. That is consistent with commentary or a project review in which the presenter explains what the platform claims and how its model is described. The supplied material does not establish that the speaker operated the platform, received a payout, or verified its performance. A favorable tone alone does not convert a review or demonstration into proof that the presenter is certifying the investment.

citations.quote: My name is David and as usual we will analyze a project that I personally found interesting.
There is no calculator available to work this out.
They have also been audited. Here we can see their documents.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The reference-side account treats every described feature as a solicitation, but the speaker is explaining the platform and its stated mechanics. The supplied material does not establish that he processed anyone’s deposit, witnessed a payout, or guaranteed performance. Even the discussion of an audit is framed as showing documents, which is evidence of examination, not proof that the presenter personally validated the investment’s outcome.

citations.quote: My name is David and as usual we will analyze a project that I personally found interesting.
They have also been audited. Here we can see their documents.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Calling the video an analysis does not make it neutral. The speaker repeatedly describes attractive returns, explains how to deposit, highlights referral earnings, and concludes with a recommendation to join. The evidence need not show that he personally processed a deposit or received a payout; the relevant conduct is presenting the opportunity to viewers. The analysis framing therefore describes the format, not the effect of the message.

citations.quote: Earn 8-11% daily ROI on your BNB token.
1 BNB in the list of the referral, you will earn 0.40 BNB.
This project already has a very big message and I recommend that you become a part of it.

opening.argument: The referral feature can be understood as an ordinary promotional incentive attached to a crypto project, not proof of a deceptive scheme. The material describes a referral bonus and provides project links, but it does not show the speaker collecting a viewer’s money, requesting passwords or private credentials, or reporting that anyone has actually been paid. The return language is qualified as an average or maximum and is tied to changing conditions, rather than presented as an unconditional guaranteed payout. The supplied evidence therefore shows promotion and explanation of a service, while leaving key scam mechanisms unestablished.

citations.quote: up to 11% daily return and 40% referral bonus.
Daily percentage is up to 11%.
Referral Link: https://bnbwinery.com/#/?ref
But the only condition is you need to have at least one deposit to start your referral earnings.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opposing account calls the deposit and referral structure a scam mechanism, but those facts alone establish only how the advertised service is described. The record does not show credential theft, money taken by the speaker, or a guaranteed payout. The referral is openly stated, and the return is expressly limited by “up to” language and changing conditions. That is promotional content, but promotion alone does not establish deception.

citations.quote: Daily percentage is up to 11%.
But the only condition is you need to have at least one deposit to start your referral earnings.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not merely an ordinary discount or loyalty promotion. The referral reward requires a deposit, and the core offer is a purported 8-11% daily return on BNB. The speaker also directs viewers toward participation and supplies a referral link. The absence of a request for passwords or proof of a completed payout does not remove the central investment solicitation; it only shows that the video does not document every possible mechanism.
